overview: The Sunday Briefing will tackle all facets of the White House beat, including the President of the United States' national and international moves as well as the key issues impacting the administration.
title: The Sunday Briefing

overview: Early risers get a chance to experience their own news, information and entertainment that "FOX and Friends" viewers get during the week with this weekend version of the show. In addition to reporting and discussion of the latest news, the show features weather forecasts to help viewers plan their weekend activities.
title: Fox & Friends Weekend

overview: Neil Morrissey was just 10-years-old when he was sent into care. He looks back at his childhood in the hope of learning how this experience has truly affected him as an adult.
title: Neil Morrissey: Care Home Kid

overview: Homicide detective Bishop Graves – brilliant, battle-scarred – will put all of his skills to the test in the hunt for an elusive killer targeting San Francisco's moneyed class. As this increasingly audacious killer develops a devoted following among the city's powerless, Bishop becomes convinced these murders connect back to SF's most powerful man, his own father, Lincoln Graves.
title: Bishop

overview: Eli Manning will host Eli's Places, a college football centric expansion of the Peyton's Places franchise, on ESPN+. Join the 2-time Super Bowl MVP as he takes on his own version of his brother's signature show to explore what makes college football a way of life across the country. Eli will travel to some of the most well-known and historic college football establishments and meet with giants in the sport to better understand what makes college football such a national sensation.
title: Eli's Places

overview: A rookie boss inherits his father's business. An ambitious bookkeeper dreams of success. Together, they learn entrepreneurship and adulthood amid crisis.
title: Typhoon Family

overview: A sweet and thrilling, 90-day fake honeymoon survival romantic comedy about a man and a woman who are trying to win the ultimate newlywed prize.
title: Would You Marry Me?

overview: A work that depicts a three-dimensional romance between a woman who 'hates summer' and a man who 'waits for summer every day' as they reunite after two years. The two people who complete their romance by examining each other from the inside out will unfold against the backdrop of summer.
title: Last Summer

overview: Danny is looking for love in all the right places, but finding all the wrong people. Born out of creator Jack Tracy's own post-pandemic dating life, this unabashedly jaw-dropping and proudly judgmental comedy series follows one single man through the hell-scape of gay courtship in New York City – where he screws his way through the apps in an increasingly desperate search for his one true love.
title: Danny Will Die Alone

overview: The Latin Grammy Awards are awarded each year since 2000 and have aired on a major Spanish network since it's inception. A Latin Grammy Award is an award by The Latin Academy of Recording Arts & Sciences to recognize outstanding achievement in the Latin music industry.
title: Latin Grammy Awards

overview: From stage school wannabe to superstar, the former Spice Girl looks back on her life as she prepares to show her brand's latest collection in Paris.
title: Victoria Beckham

overview: In Los Mufas: suerte para la desgracia, Roque, a paranormal journalist, teams up with the most dangerous "mufa" in Argentina, Vicente, to conduct an investigation that will change the course of his life. They both want to find a solution to this phenomenon that affects certain people, involuntarily and inexplicably producing ruins and storms around them. However, Roque's powerful, multimillionaire boss doesn't want this report to come to light. In return, he offers Roque an unusual assignment, in exchange for a large sum of money: to free his daughter from a "mufa cult" and save her from the clutches of a perverse and psychopathic parapsychologist. Although Roque's path seems to be uphill, the adventures he experiences with Vicente will give meaning to his life again and help him heal family wounds from yesterday and today.
title: Los Mufas: suerte para la desgracia

overview: Always, Lady London takes fans inside the defining chapter of Lady London's career: the making of her debut album, To Whom It May Concern. With a major-label release and worldwide tour on the line and while facing grief, doubt, and the relentless pressure to deliver - she is determined to prove she's more than a viral moment.
title: Always, Lady London

overview: The Friday the 13th Murders which explores dark and twisted cases that occurred on the calendar's most feared date - Friday the 13th.
title: The Friday the 13th Murders
Tang Detective: The Broken Mirror Conspiracy

overview: In the early Republic of China, Qian Yiyu, the adopted daughter of Qian Fan—the old butler of the wealthy Liu family—grew up as childhood sweethearts with Liu Sinan, the second young master, and the two were engaged to be married. However, on the night of their wedding, she was suddenly forced to marry Liu Silin, Liu Sinan's deranged elder brother. Resentful toward the man who took the place of her beloved, Yiyu must still pretend everything is fine—for she has a secret mission: to help Liu Sinan spy on his brother. It turns out that the elder brother's downfall was orchestrated by Liu Sinan himself, who seeks to seize the entire family fortune. Yet, despite Yiyu's hostility and defiance, Liu Silin treats her with patience and tenderness. As Yiyu continues to watch over him, she is gradually moved by his kindness, and love quietly blossoms between them. But their fragile affection is constantly tested by manipulation and deceit—eventually uncovering the shocking truth behind the murder of Yiyu's biological parents.
title: Time Reveals the Prince's Heart

overview: Disgraced former film queen Lin Zhiyu has the ability to foresee a person's next thirty days through brief skin contact. After predicting that her one-night stand, Shen Youchuan, will kill her, she flees in fear—only to become repeatedly entangled with him. Torn between escaping a foretold death and fighting to reclaim her career, Lin Zhiyu is forced to confront a fate where danger and destiny may be one and the same.
title: 3 Seconds to You

overview: A former ballerina turned Vegas showgirl decides to take a gamble on a new marriage and a fresh start in Paradise, CA.
title: Bunheads
Bao Qing Hou Ye Chi Qing Qie
He Ping Jing Ying: Jia You Te Zhong Bing!

overview: Detectives chase down leads, prosecutors go head-to-head with defense attorneys, and juries wrestle with life-or-death decisions.
title: Killer Investigations

overview: Australia, this is Big Brother. Standby for an important announcement. The show that made TV history is coming home. Big Brother is back on 10, back at Dreamworld, and back on your screens this November. Hosted by Mel Tracina, the reboot will feature everything you loved in the noughties: live nominations, live evictions, and all the action live from Dreamworld. Fans don't just want to watch the OG show, they want to be in it. With 20,000 housemate applications already received, Australia has never been readier for a return of the original and the best. Big Brother is always watching, and this November, so can you.
title: Big Brother

overview: In this brand-new series for TG4, renowned singer and musician Nell Ní Chróinín takes viewers on a heartfelt musical journey through rural Ireland. Ceol ón gCré (Music from the Earth) is a 4-part traditional music and documentary hybrid series exploring the deep well of tradition, memory, and community across the country. Each episode focuses on a core theme of rural life – the land, the sea, the heart, and the soul – with Nell meeting musicians, singers, and dancers who embody these connections through powerful performances and personal stories. Filmed in a warm, informal style, this is a series that unearths the true spirit of Irish tradition in the modern day.
title: Ceol ón gCré

overview: Katie Hannon delves into the secrets held in Ireland's National Archives in a new series ofThe Records Show starting this Sunday on RTÉ One and RTÉ Player. Over three episodes, Katie digs out previously undisturbed documents from the hundreds of thousands of records held at the National Archives before heading across the country to follow the trail of the stories behind them. The Records Show takes Katie from the surface of the moon to Steven Spielberg's County Wicklow bunker and then to the epicenter of Ireland's international sports car industry – Castleblaney, County Monaghan. She hears of a no-nonsense judge and his moral vigilantes, a plan to turn Nelson's Pillar into Ireland's Statue of Liberty, an illegal arrival who has lunch with the President of Ireland and both Lennon and McCartney turn up in the first episode. The stories from the Archives that feature in The Records Show are about astronauts, rock stars, Hollywood actors and royal banquets. But more than anything, the series is about people and the lives lived in Ireland.
title: The Records Show

overview: Opensource came to change the world, but he changed himself. Russian journalist and science popularizer Andreyka Konev is next to him-expert Vladimir understands how to live further today. The leading program, the author and the head of IT, she also answers the main question: what is expertise, what is progress or what does a tough corporate player need for this? The principles of a free community are being tested: a developer is suing a company that is trying to steal his work, Russia is being pushed out of international open-source projects, and new ecosystems are being born out of the wreckage.
title: Свободный код

overview: One chance encounter forever changes the lives of Oksana, a young girl from a simple family, and Sergey, a young oligarch. It all starts with the wedding. Oksana's sister Tanya is getting married. The wedding day turns into a series of disasters - literally everything is not going according to plan. Tanya's ex-lover even appears at the wedding. And the self-confident rich man Sergey makes an offer to Oksana in front of everyone. Oksana's refusal really hurts Sergey: "And even if you say no a thousand times, sooner or later you'll say yes anyway!"
title: Тысяча «нет» и одно «да»

overview: A midnight massacre at the Babel Villa in Mystic City. The homeowner is found decapitated, and his wife dies by self-immolation. Two deaths in one night ignite an urban legend. Months later, six individuals gather at Towel of Babel, seeking the truth behind the will, unaware that they have already walked into the snare of fate. As secrets surface and dangers lurk in every shadow, no one will emerge unscathed. Beneath the web of deceit, what is the real truth?
title: Tower of Babel

overview: After her escort agency family is destroyed, He Fuyi plunges over a cliff with the ancient artifact, the Seven-Star Lamp. Her blood awakens the lamp's spirit, A Qi, binding them together in a symbiotic fate. To avenge her family and sustain her own life, she embarks on a perilous quest with A Qi to "dissolve dreams and shatter obsessions." Thrust into the turmoil of the late Qing Dynasty, they join forces with the nobleman Little Fifth Master. Witnessing countless human sorrows and enduring attachments, they finally unravel a truth that will shake the very foundations of their world.
title: The Dreamwalker

overview: From brown gravy to world-class! This is the miraculous story of how Denmark became a gastronomic powerhouse - and what it cost along the way
title: Det danske madmirakel

overview: In a magical corner of Zambia lies an extraordinary valley – a place where Africa's most charismatic animals live shoulder to shoulder. This series tells enchanting stories about the characters who call this place home, from the struggles of a baby elephant to a baboon born an outsider. From the smallest, to the tallest, a cast of engaging and intriguing animals brings this untamed African wonderland to life.
title: Zambia Untamed

overview: America's Best Dance Crew, often abbreviated as ABDC, is an American competitive dance reality television series that features both national and international dance crews. The show was produced by singer, record producer, and former American Idol judge Randy Jackson. The series premiered on February 7, 2008, on MTV. It was originally developed for NBC as World Moves.
title: America's Best Dance Crew

overview: Nene Leakes opens up her life and invites celebrity guests to engage in candid, unfiltered conversations about relationships, careers, and the latest gossip
title: The NeNe Leakes Show

overview: This mini-series includes short stories adapted from 6 different manga series, all centered around the theme of gay love.
title: 6 Lovers

overview: Chandamama was an old Doordarshan (DD) television serial for children, produced by Kamini Kaushal and Rahul Sood, which aired on a Doordarshan channel i.e. DD National or another regional DD channel such as Doordarshan Sahyadri. The show was designed for children's entertainment, information, and education, combining old stories with new content to align with changing trends.
title: Chandamama

overview: Jackanory was a long-running BBC children's television series that was designed to stimulate an interest in reading. The show was first transmitted on 13 December 1965, the first story being the fairy-tale Cap-o'-Rushes read by Lee Montague. It aired from December 13, 1965 - March 24, 1996. The show's format involved an actor reading from children's novels or folk tales, usually while seated in an armchair. From time to time the scene being read would be illustrated by a specially commissioned still drawing.
title: Jackanory

overview: Álvaro and Carlos are two inmates recently arrived at a juvenile correctional facility located by the sea. While serving their sentences, they must face threats from the Los Pajaritos gang without losing hope in an increasingly dark future. But there, they also find support from inmates like Saray, a young woman who prefers to live in the facility rather than return to her troubled life on the outside, and from staff like Mario, a man who will risk his own life to help these children.
title: Mar afuera

overview: Above Average Presents is a Peacock series featuring a collection of comedic sketches and skits performed by a diverse range of comedians and talented individuals, including figures like Tina Fey, Jason Sudeikis, and Reggie Watts, with each episode presenting humorous and creative scenarios that showcase the show's high-quality and hilarious content.
title: Above Average Presents

overview: Series of documentaries looking at the careers of four titans of African-American music: Janet Jackson, Prince, Lionel Richie and Public Enemy.
title: New Power Generation: Black Music Legends of the 1980s

overview: Some of the world's greatest tribute acts go head to head, performing songs made famous by music legends.
title: Even Better Than the Real Thing

overview: Gareth Malone and Karen Gibson reveal the stories and legends behind some of Britain's Christmas traditions.
title: Britain's Christmas Story

overview: The story of convicted killer Joseph Naso, and how a fellow inmate came to connect him to many additional cold cases, with the help of Investigators.
title: Death Row Confidential: Secrets of a Serial Killer

overview: Four women who are nothing alike end up living together in a flat in England.
title: Girls on Top

overview: In this high-stakes drama, an ambitious outsider and his friends navigate the chaotic, larger-than-life, yet uncertain world of Bollywood.
title: The Ba***ds of Bollywood
She Woke up from the Coffin
The Night Conveys Love to Lovers

overview: Car makeover competition. Two teams battle it out for the spoils of a car auction.
title: Cuibhlichean an Fhortain

overview: When it comes to chasing criminals, two wheels are better than four. In this brand new high-octane series, nowhere is off limits for the country's highly trained police bikers. They are the UK's fastest responders, at the ready to race at top speed to save lives and catch suspects on the run.
title: Traffic Cops: Pursuit Squad One
Shao Nian Ge Xing Zh Feng Hua Xue Yue

overview: Mai Tian, the sole survivor of the fallen Shen family, saves the life of Crown Prince Jinchuan, who is gravely wounded and has lost his memory. To evade an imperial marriage decree, she seizes the chance to enter into a marriage of convenience with him. What begins as a contractual union unexpectedly blossoms into genuine love and deep attachment. Ultimately, joining forces, they unravel a colossal imperial examination fraud and succeed in clearing the Shen family's name.
title: Spring Night

overview: In the attractive seaside resort of Tisvilde on the North Zealand coast, a music festival has divided the residents into two camps. The annual festival has grown so large that it has transformed the otherwise idyllic and peaceful summer oasis into a town of conflict and irreconcilability. The question is what kind of town should Tisvilde be, and who actually has the right to decide that?
title: Slaget om Tisvilde

overview: Look What You Made Me Do explores cases of revenge and betrayal. The series features real courtroom footage and first-hand accounts to detail shocking acts of vengeance.
title: Look What You Made Me Do
Largados e Pelados Brasil: A Tribo

overview: TG4 has announced the launch of a powerful new documentary series, Néara-Éagsúlacht: Dearcadh Difriúil produced by Tyrone Productions, which will air as part of TG4's Autumn schedule. The two-part series offers a moving and honest insight into the lives of neurodivergent people across Ireland, filmed over the course of a year. The series shines a light on the challenges and triumphs faced by neurodivergent individuals and their families, while highlighting the importance of understanding, inclusion, and support in education, employment, and wider society.
title: Néara-Éagsúlacht: Dearcadh Difriúil

overview: Canada AM was a Canadian morning television news show that aired on CTV from 1972 to 2016. Its final hosts were Beverly Thomson and Marci Ien, with Jeff Hutcheson presenting the weather forecast and sports. The program aired on weekdays, and was produced from CTV's facilities at 9 Channel Nine Court in Scarborough, Toronto.
title: Canada AM

overview: Keitaro has finally passed the entrance exams, and is officially a Toudai student. But after breaking his leg in an accident in the entrance ceremony, he thought and re-evaluated himself. Having new goals, Keitaro follows Seta on an overseas archeology trip. During his absence, however, all was not well in Hinata Lodge. Urashima Kanako, Keitaro's sister, arrives on the scene. She claims to be the new manager of Hinata Lodge starts to go against all the tenants. Things become even more complicated when they recieve a letter from Keitaro. The tenants and Kanako made a big mess trying to get the letter, but Seta's car crashes in before anyone could read the letter... Love Hina Again is an OVA series and a direct continuation to Love Hina TV anime.
title: Love Hina Again

overview: The residents of the multi-storey building decided to create a shared chat in order to solve possible problems in relations with the organization serving the house and communicate with neighbors.
title: ДомоЧАТцы

overview: When Serhat was a boy, life struck him twice — his father abandoned the family, and their fortune vanished. He rebuilt his life through sheer will, becoming a successful businessman devoted to two values: family and integrity. But everything shattered when he learned his wife Berrak had been hiding a devastating secret. Before he could confront her, a tragic accident left her in a coma — taking the truth with her. Then came Zeynep. A fiery, outspoken young woman from a working-class neighborhood, she was nothing like anyone Serhat had known. Drawn together by the mystery surrounding Berrak, Serhat and Zeynep found themselves caught between mistrust and desire, ice and fire. As Serhat searched for the truth, Zeynep fought to keep his heart from turning to stone. This is the story of love and betrayal, of shadows and light — because some flowers bloom in darkness, and some stories begin only after the last chapter ends.
title: Güller ve Günahlar

overview: A gang of skaters operates in Moscow, fighting for justice with bizarre methods. The helmeted criminals attack bribe-takers and brand them with the word "karma." A young, fresh graduate of the police academy, Alexey Yudin, is tasked with infiltrating the gang disguised as a skateboarder. Accompanied by his new friend, Max, he masters the board and becomes part of the skater community. But the further the mission progresses, the more difficult it becomes for Alexey to maintain impartiality. Yudin himself seems to be imbued with the noble gangsters' ideals and increasingly uncertain whose side he's on.
title: Разворот

overview: After the sudden death of their lifelong friend Adriana, Evelina and Milla reunite in their seaside hometown. Once inseparable, the two women had drifted apart, but grief brings them back together. As they confront old wounds and rediscover the strength of their bond, they begin to suspect that Adriana's death may not have been accidental. Between family tensions, hidden secrets, and the challenges of middle age, their renewed friendship becomes both a refuge and a driving force in uncovering the truth.
title: Balene - Amiche per Sempre

overview: The Little Reunion follows the lives of a dynamic group of outspoken and unstoppable women with dwarfism navigating new opportunities in the sun-soaked streets of Los Angeles. The new chapter starts now, reuniting cast members from the Little Women franchise, starring Tonya Renee Banks and Christy McGinity from Little Women: LA, along with Amanda Salinas and Andrea Salinas (known as "Tiny Twinz") and Tiffany Becton (known as "Monie") from Little Women: Atlanta, as well as Briana Barlup (known as "Left Cheek") from Little Women: Atlanta and Little Women: Dallas.
title: The Little Reunion

overview: Following "The Little Reunion" and its shocking revelations, ladies living with dwarfism start a new chapter with old friends, new faces and big opportunities.
title: Little Hollywood

overview: Champions for Change spotlights extraordinary innovators and everyday people using grit, creativity, and compassion to drive positive change and tackle some of the world's most pressing issues
title: Champions for Change

overview: High pressure quiz show where contestants battle it out over increasingly difficult rounds for a chance to answer A Question of Genius and win a cash prize.
title: A Question of Genius
Fu Xing Wang Fei Zai Xian Da Lian
Ji Zhang Xian Sheng, Ni De Wei Hun Qi Jia Ren Le
Jiu Zhong Chun Se Suo Qian Sui

overview: Crackerjack was a British children's television series that aired on the BBC Television Service from 14 September 1955 until 21 December 1984. The shows were filmed in front of an audience largely of children, at the BBC Television Theatre & the format of the programme included competitive games for teams of children, a music spot, a comedy double act, and a finale in which the cast performs a short comic play, The show was introduced with the phrase "It's Friday, it's five o'clock. . . It's Crackerjack!"
title: Crackerjack

overview: Five years ago, Wu Nongyu followed her brother Wu Siyuan to the scene of a murder, where her life became entwined with Xie Xinxu, who was then suspected to be the killer. Her very presence seemed to exert a strange, instinctive pull on him. A single glance was enough to awaken an uncontrollable desire to possess her.Five years later, determined to have Wu Nongyu, Xie Xinxu disguises himself as a cold, ascetic medical professor and deliberately draws close to her. Step by step, he lays his traps, guiding her into falling in love with him, and the two embark on a perilous journey together. A man born with an extreme lack of empathy, almost mad by nature, gradually learns what normal human emotions feel like through his constant companionship with a girl as warm and radiant as the sun.
title: Affinity

overview: A fraudulent influencer's occult divinations lead to a bizarre kidnapping. Within twenty-four hours, layer upon layer of conspiracy reveals unspeakable secrets. Three intricately connected groups of characters expose a hidden plot beneath a seemingly calm surface. A glamorous influencer, a black-market kidnapper, and a shady banker take the stage, each scrambling to survive or save the day, and each making a disgraceful spectacle of themselves.
title: Tracks in the Snow

overview: History enthusiast Shi Feifan wakes up in the fictional "Great Southern Dynasty" as his dissolute namesake. To protect his family, he appears to squander wealth, while secretly using modern knowledge to amass a fortune through silk trading, outwit the Qiang envoy, rescue the Grand Princess, and eliminate the malevolent Prince. All with the Emperor's tacit approval. Subsequently, he is sent to reorganize the Western Army, transforming from a good-for-nothing into the dynasty's unseen pillar, who secretly holds military power.
title: Extraordinary

overview: A half-century ago, the sudden emergence of spiritual energy within jadeite gave rise to espers and powerful clans. The Meng family, gifted with the ability to sense this energy, was brutally wiped out overnight. The sole survivor, a youth named Meng Yan, forged a life with a mysterious girl named Xiaoduo. Six years later, having mastered his powers, Meng Yan embarks on a path of vengeance, igniting a metropolitan superpower war that spans two generations.
title: Search For Soul Stone

overview: The Brownlow Medal awards show is an annual event, traditionally held at Crown Melbourne on the Monday before the AFL Grand Final, to present the Charles Brownlow Medal, awarded to the AFL's fairest and best player of the season. The event features a "red carpet" (often humorously called the "Gownlow"), where players and their partners arrive, followed by a live count of the votes. The count, hosted by the AFL, involves the AFL CEO reading the votes for each match, interspersed with highlights and commentary, leading to the announcement of the winner.
title: The Brownlow Medal

overview: Тримайся, братику is a war drama. The plot follows two best friends, Alex and Nikolai, medical students at the start of a full-scale Russian invasion, as they try to find work at a military hospital. Along with a casual acquaintance, Sasha, they find themselves at a stabilization point in the east, near the front lines. Every day, the film's characters face death, undergo their own personal transformations, endure personal dramas, and expose traitors. This is a story about friendship, extreme adolescence, and true values.
title: Тримайся, братику

overview: What will happen when "Khao Jee," an Isan boy who comes to the city to work in a factory, gets the chance to live in the same condominium as "Fah Kram," the factory owner's son and his cold, distant boss? Follow their special story—will love bloom between them? Or will it turn into a heart-shaking drama as always?
title: Neon Flower Waiting for Love

overview: Antigang will follow the adventures of detective sergeants Jean-François, Mathilde, Philippe, Carolanne, and Tommy, led by Lieutenant Christian. The squad finds itself at the heart of the conflicts between the country's criminal organizations. Each character experiences personal, familial, and romantic challenges. Antigang will also reveal the repercussions and consequences suffered by the families of the leaders of the underworld, not to mention the anxieties that haunt the daily lives of source agents and informants, torn between the mask of their loyalty and their true betrayals. The series dissects the modus operandi of police forces to better understand their investigative work, their strategies, and how they weave their web around criminal organizations with the ultimate goal of dismantling them. Will they succeed? If so, at what cost?
title: Antigang

overview: Home James! was a British television sitcom which aired from 1987 to 1990, starring comedian Jim Davidson, who played the role of Jim London. The show was a sequel to the sitcom, Up the Elephant and Round the Castle. Jim London (Jim Davidson) is a working class cockney lad who lands a job as a chauffeur for businessman Robert Palmer (George Sewell) who has had his driving licence withdrawn. Palmer's butler (Harry Towb) doesn't approve of Jim but gradually accepts him.
title: Home James!
